meta.title: From Salonica to Of (example)
meta.sourcesText:
The family in this example is fictional; the history of the places is real and cited in the report.
Narration: generated locally. Map: Natural Earth; period borders CShapes 2.0 (Schvitz et al. 2022, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), approximate. Dotted routes are representative.

selanik.title: A port city
say: Your story begins in 1895 in Salonica, one of the busiest ports of the Ottoman Empire. Your great-grandfather Ali was born here.
At the turn of the century the city's largest community was Jewish; they shared the same bazaar with Muslims, Greeks and Bulgarians.
Five years later, in 1900, your great-grandmother Emine was born in the same city.

balkan.title: The border moves
facts: W|8 November 1912 · Greek army enters Salonica
say: In the autumn of 1912 the Balkan War reached the city gates. On the 8th of November the Greek army entered Salonica.
Ali was seventeen, and the city he was born in now belonged to another state.
Five years later, in August 1917, a great fire burned down the historic centre of the city.

mubadele.title: One steamer, one trunk
facts: W|30 January 1923 · Exchange convention at Lausanne
say: Under the convention signed at Lausanne on the 30th of January 1923, the Muslims of Greece and the Greeks of Turkey were to be exchanged.
The family says that in 1924 Ali and Emine boarded a steamer with a single trunk.
They crossed the Aegean and landed in Izmir. Behind them, the city of their birth; ahead, a life they had never seen.

izmir.title: A first child in a new city
say: In 1925 your great-grandfather Hasan was born in Izmir, the family's first child born in this land.
With the Surname Law of 1934 the family took the name Örnek, the name you carry today.

of.title: Meanwhile, on the Black Sea
say: Meanwhile, more than a thousand kilometres to the east, in the Of district of Trabzon, your mother's father Mehmet was born.
Three years later, in 1938, your mother's mother Zehra was born in the same district.

istanbul.title: Two lines meet
say: In 1960 your father Murat was born in Izmir, and in 1964 your mother Ayşe in Of.
The two lines met in Istanbul, and in 1988 they married.
In the spring of 1992, in Kadikoy, you were born.

hepsi.title: One map, one family
say: One side of you begins in the harbour of Salonica, the other on the slopes of Of.
Your story is where two seas and a hundred years meet.
